sections.label: SLA leasing procedures compliance
sections.summary: SLA complied with its internal processes and requirements, and the properties were rented at market value set by independent valuers.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: On this last point, the short answer is that SLA complied with all its procedures and requirements in these transactions.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: SLA adhered to its internal processes, guidelines and requirements in leasing both properties.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: The properties were rented at market value, determined by an independent team of valuers who, as Members heard from the Senior Minister earlier, were not aware of the identities of the prospective tenants at the time of the transaction.

sections.label: CPIB rental transactions findings
sections.summary: CPIB found the rules were applied fairly and there was no evidence of corruption or wrongdoing in the two Ridout Road rentals.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Following this investigation, CPIB found that the rules were applied fairly for both rental transactions.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: It was established that there was no evidence of corruption or wrongdoing in the two rental transactions of the Ridout Road state properties.

sections.label: Black and White conservation assessment
sections.summary: URA assessed 26 and 31 Ridout Road for conservation, considering them intact historic bungalows and good examples of the black and white style.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: At present, there are 36 conserved Black and Whites, and a further 235 state-owned Black and Whites are marked for study for conservation; and hence, in the meantime, they are protected.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: In assessing 26 and 31 Ridout Road for conservation, URA took into account the following: first, these are two intact remaining historic bungalows built in the early 1900s; second, they are good examples of the "black and white" architectural style which had been built by the Public Works Department of the colonial British government, which was responsible for building infrastructure, such as roads, bridges, irrigation works and so on, as well as for providing accommodation for Government servants who oversaw such works.

sections.label: Heritage protection and redevelopment balance
sections.summary: A balance is needed between protecting heritage properties and redeveloping them, so some bungalows are retained while others are demolished.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: A judicious balance is necessary, particularly between protecting heritage properties in Singapore and redeveloping them altogether.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Hence, whilst we continue to retain some of the heritage bungalows for their original residential use on the rental market, some others have been demolished as a cluster to make way for newer developments.

sections.label: 50 Bah Soon Pah Road conservation study
sections.summary: A standalone Black and White at 50 Bah Soon Pah Road is under study to be conserved and integrated within a new HDB residential area.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: A standalone Black and White at 50 Bah Soon Pah Road, which used to house the executive of a rubber estate, is under study to be conserved and integrated within a new HDB residential area.

sections.label: Rochester Park conserved bungalows reuse
sections.summary: Twelve conserved bungalows at Rochester Park are retained in form within Rochester Commons, with F&B and office uses.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Twelve conserved bungalows at Rochester Park have been put to new uses at Rochester Commons, a new integrated campus-style development in one-north by CapitaLand.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Standing on a 2.4-hectare site, the mixed development will have an office tower, hotel, as well as 12 conserved bungalows which are retained in their form, the bungalows themselves, with F&B and office uses.

sections.label: Seletar Camp Black and Whites demolished
sections.summary: A cluster of 174 Black and Whites in Seletar Camp were demolished to make way for an industrial park.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: For instance, a cluster of 174 Black and Whites in Seletar Camp were previously demolished to make way for an industrial park.

sections.label: Land sales based on planning needs
sections.summary: Singapore's land sales approach is based primarily on planning and development needs, not mainly on maximising proceeds.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Singapore's approach to land sales is primarily based on planning and development needs and not mainly to maximise land sales proceeds.

sections.label: Conservation upkeep of Black and Whites
sections.summary: Conserved and protected Black and Whites are subject to conservation and protection requirements, and SLA invests significantly in upkeeping and maintaining them.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: They are also subject to conservation and protection requirements.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: I would add that, particularly for conserved Black and Whites and those which are protected whilst being studied for conservation, SLA invests a significant amount in upkeeping and maintaining the properties.

sections.label: Restoration guidelines for key elements
sections.summary: Restoration guidelines specify design, location and material for key elements including roofs, facades, outhouse, floors, staircases, finishes, colours, air-conditioning and exhaust fans.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: The restoration guidelines will specify details, such as the design, location and material that can be used for all key elements, such as the roofs, building facades, outhouse, floors, staircases, internal finishes, building colours and even in the context of air-conditioning and exhaust fans.

sections.label: Longer tenancies and leasehold periods
sections.summary: SLA grants 5+4 year tenancies for larger capital expenditure and is studying longer leasehold periods such as 30 or 60 years in an estate en bloc.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: In suitable cases where tenants are prepared to commit larger sums of capital expenditure to enhance the properties, SLA has been prepared to grant tenancies of 5+4 years.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: So, 5+4, instead of the 3+3+3 years, so that there is a longer lead time in the initial tenancy period to recover the amortised cost of the capital expenditure.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: In addition, SLA is also studying the feasibility of extending even longer leasehold periods, for example, 30 or 60 years, in an estate en bloc, so that a private developer can come in as the master-leaseholder and rejuvenate the entire estate and then be able to upkeep the properties in the meantime as well as reap the benefits over a longer lease period.

sections.label: Gross floor area determines rent
sections.summary: The gross floor area is the guiding component in determining the rent.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: First, the gross floor area (GFA) is the guiding component in determining the rent.

sections.label: Rental and occupancy rates report
sections.summary: Senior Minister Teo's report sets out comparable rental and occupancy rates for state-owned Black and Whites and private properties.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: In his report, Senior Minister Teo has set out the comparable rental and occupancy rates for both state-owned Black and Whites as well as private properties.

sections.label: Ridout Road occupancy and tenancies
sections.summary: Ridout Road estate occupancy rose from 71% in January 2018 to 100% in January 2022, and in 2019 four of 14 nearby Black and White tenants requested pre-termination.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: In January 2018, the occupancy at Ridout Road estate was 71%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: This increased to 100% occupancy in January 2022 and has stayed at 100% since that time.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: In 2019, four tenants, out of 14 Black and Whites in the vicinity, requested to pre-terminate their tenancies.

sections.label: GCB rent versus Black and Whites
sections.summary: Average land area rent per square foot per month for private detached homes in GCB areas is three to five times higher than comparable Black and White rent.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: The average land area rent per square foot per month for private detached homes in GCB areas is between three and five times higher, compared to the comparable rent by land area for Black and Whites.

sections.label: State properties listed on SPIO
sections.summary: All residential state properties available for rent are today listed on SPIO.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: In respect of property marketing, today, all residential state properties available for rent are listed on SPIO.

sections.label: SLA reverts to SPIO listing
sections.summary: In August 2022, as the market revived, SLA reverted to requiring all properties to be listed on SPIO.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: In August 2022, as the market revived and picked up, SLA reverted to requiring all properties to be listed on SPIO.

sections.label: Valuation after tenant inquiry
sections.summary: When a prospective tenant inquires after successful marketing, a valuation is necessary to ascertain the property's valuation for leasing.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Upon successful marketing, when a prospective tenant makes an inquiry, it would be necessary to conduct a valuation to ascertain the valuation of the property being considered for leasing.

sections.label: Leasing request for valuation
sections.summary: The leasing team submits a valuation request with proposed lease parameters, and the valuation team determines the guide rent.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Typically, the leasing team would submit a request for valuation of a particular property, setting out the parameters of the proposed lease of the property, and the valuation team will then determine the guide rent for the property.

sections.label: SLA valuation team baseline
sections.summary: The independent SLA valuation team assesses market value for Black and Whites and gives the leasing division a baseline to achieve.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: The independent SLA valuation team, which looks at valuation for Black and Whites, will assess the market value and give the leasing division a baseline that must be achieved for the property in question.

sections.label: Open bidding allocation process
sections.summary: Under open bidding, the property is listed on SPIO for at least 14 days, then offered to the highest bidder.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Today, under an open bidding allocation, the property would be listed on SPIO for at least 14 days.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Once the bidding window closes, the tenancy is offered to the highest bidder.

sections.label: Tender awards published on SPIO
sections.summary: The highest bid rent and tender results are published on SPIO for six months.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: On Mr Louis Chua's question as to the publication of tender awards on SLA's website, the highest bid rent in the tender and tender results are published on SPIO for six months.

sections.label: SLA valuer did not know tenant
sections.summary: SLA must know the prospective tenant's identity, but the valuation department and valuer did not know it was Minister Shanmugam.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: SLA has to know the identity of the prospective tenant in order to process and assess the bid.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: But the SLA valuation department and the SLA valuer who assessed the guide rent on 26 Ridout Road, did not know that the prospective tenant was Minister Shanmugam.

sections.label: External consultant cost for Ridout Road
sections.summary: This aspect, as assessed by the external consultant, cost about $375,000 of the $515,400 total for 26 Ridout Road.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Together, this aspect, as assessed by the external consultant, cost about $375,000 out of the total amount of $515,400 incurred for 26 Ridout Road.

sections.label: Ridout Road sprucing up cost
sections.summary: The sprucing up works for 31 Ridout Road cost around $118,000.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: The total cost of the sprucing up works for 31 Ridout Road cost around $118,000.

sections.label: Shanmugam improvement works spending
sections.summary: Minister Shanmugam spent in excess of $400,000 on these improvement works.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Minister Shanmugam spent in excess of $400,000 on these improvement works.

sections.label: Balakrishnan improvement works cost
sections.summary: Minister Balakrishnan undertook improvement works costing around $200,000, including air-conditioning, toilet upgrades and a garage pavilion.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Minister Balakrishnan similarly undertook improvement works with a cost of around $200,000, including installing air-conditioning, upgrading the toilets and building a pavilion as an extension of the property's garage.

sections.label: Trees removed at Ridout property
sections.summary: Nineteen trees of girth size more than one metre were removed since the tenancy began, each time upon safety feedback.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Nineteen trees of girth size more than one metre were removed on various occasions since the tenancy commenced about four-and-a-half years ago, each time upon feedback that the trees may pose safety issues.

sections.label: NParks approval to remove trees
sections.summary: NParks approved removing 24 such trees after an arborist's assessment showed they were at risk of failure.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Approval was granted by NParks to remove 24 such trees after an independent arborist's assessment showed that these trees were at risk of failure and posed safety concerns.

sections.label: Rental offers met guide rent
sections.summary: For both properties, offers of rental were made which met the guide rent.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: For both properties, offers of rental were made which met the guide rent.

sections.label: 26 Ridout Road maintenance cost
sections.summary: Maintaining the additional heavily vegetated area at 26 Ridout Road would cost the tenant about $25,000 yearly, giving SLA a reasonable commercial basis for the transactions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: In addition, in the case of 26 Ridout Road, the cost of maintaining the additional heavily vegetated area would then fall on the tenant and this would have been in the order of $25,000 per year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: In these circumstances, there was every reasonable, commercial basis for SLA to have entered into those transactions.

sections.label: AGO audit of SLA
sections.summary: AGO last audited SLA in financial year 2018/2019, covering April 2016 through June 2018.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: AGO last audited SLA in financial year 2018/2019.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: This covered the period April 2016 through to June 2018.
